# Airwindows effects of the effect library (MIT, see LICENSE.md); generated by tools/vendor_airwindows.py.
# Always optimised but without fast math, so the effects sound exactly like the originals.
file(GLOB AIRWINDOWS_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/autogen_airwin/*.cpp)
add_library(airwindows STATIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/airwin_consolidated_base.cpp ${AIRWINDOWS_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(airwindows PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set_target_properties(airwindows PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(airwindows PRIVATE /W0 /O2 /utf-8)
    target_compile_definitions(airwindows PRIVATE _USE_MATH_DEFINES NOMINMAX _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
else()
    target_compile_options(airwindows PRIVATE -w -O2)
endif()
